notes:
CRM notes:
- Team: product-led mid-market analytics SaaS, core product uses semantic search for in-app help + knowledge surfaces.
- Primary contact: Claire Dwyer (Head of Product) + engineering lead Raj Patel.
- Wants hosted API first for time-to-value, but committed to Dedicated if throughput + unit cost hit targets.
- POC scope: nightly batch embed job (2M docs), near-real-time similarity queries for UI (~100 qps steady, spikes to 600 qps), recall-focused ranking.
- Observed: during hosted POC single-embed latency great but batch throughput hit limits due to concurrency caps; experimenting with parallelization.
- Quote from Claire: "We need predictable cost for our enterprise tier — spikes can't triple our bill."
- Security: must support SSO/SAML, KMS for key management, SOC2 audit artifacts. Data residency: primarily US but must support EU-only residency for a subset of customers.
- Vector DB: currently prototyping with Pinecone and Milvus; key ask: seamless Redwood-hosted -> vector DB connector and predictable export costs.
- Integration: upcoming integration work to swap out their homemade embedding pipeline if Redwood batching/caching reduces cost.
- Commercial: target ARR $75k-$150k; procurement in flight, legal wants DPA + standard redlines.
- Risks: legal timeline (3-6 weeks), engineering resources to run POC, uncertain ROI if embedding unit cost doesn't drop.
- Next: Maya to deliver POC perf report (latency p50/p95/p99, cost per 1M tokens, batch throughput) by 2/10; Jordan to schedule dedicated sizing call 2/12.
- Internal notes: evaluate whether Dedicated autoscaling with burst capacity handles nightly 2M doc job without degraded search latency during daytime spikes.
use_case_summary: Mid-market SaaS needs embeddings-first semantic search for in-app knowledge and product analytics. Evaluating hosted API to accelerate POC, then Dedicated for committed throughput and cost predictability. Key metrics: batch embed throughput (docs/hour), embedding unit cost, query latency p50/p95/p99 under mixed workload.
technical_requirements:
- Embed 2M docs nightly (target >= 200k docs/hour)
- Serve 100 qps steady semantic search with 600 qps spike handling
- Max p95 query latency <= 150ms for UI queries
- Native connector to Pinecone + option to export to Milvus/Weaviate
- SSO/SAML and KMS integration
- Audit logs + retention controls for 12 months
poc_scope:
2-week perf POC:
- Phase A (hosted): run nightly embed job, measure throughput and cost, instrument KV/prefix caching benefits.
- Phase B (dedicated sizing): run simulated daytime query traffic with background batch job to test interference and autoscale.
- Deliverable: perf dashboard (latency histograms), cost model, recommended Dedicated config and commit band.
pricing_notes: Requested committed capacity pricing with monthly commit bands (small/medium/large). Interested in blended pricing if nightly batch jobs are off-peak. Ask: show delta hosted API vs Dedicated TCO for 12-month horizon.
